hypotheses.N1_generic_power_law_bulk: Both null families retain median bulk log-log R2 at least 0.90 and median exponent within 0.20 of the observed map.
hypotheses.N2_observed_outlier_excess: Observed mean top-four log excess above the fitted bulk exceeds the maximum across all sign and pairing null replicates.
hypotheses.N3_semantic_outlier_components: At least eight of the leading 32 observed output components have best oriented token-predicate AUROC at least 0.70.
hypotheses.N4_semantics_exceed_null: The observed count of semantic leading components exceeds the maximum count across all null replicates.
hypotheses.N5_not_just_write_pca: Mean canonical overlap between the leading 16 query-map output components and leading 16 natural-write PCs is below 0.50.
